description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Alluxio 3.6.0 mounted in FUSE mode pointing to AWS S3. System config: 1 clients, 2 servers, 5 total accelerators. No code modifications were made to the MLPerf scripts.
run_command: mlpstorage training run --hosts 127.0.0.1 --num-client-hosts 1 --client-host-memory-in-gb 100 --num-accelerators 5 --accelerator-type H100 --model cosmoflow  --data-dir /mnt/alluxio/alluxio-fuse/gemini/cosmoflow_189808_500GB --results-dir /home/ubuntu/mlps_results  --param dataset.num_files_train=189808  --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe
